label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交在把字典挂接到“刚清空的”工作流时新增一个状态标记（tableType 不再视为已清空表），供后续 LZ4_prepareTable() 判断：这是流对象内部状态与复用契约的新增，表面上与隐式 state 阳性相同。但 round_trip_stream_fuzzer 会在 LZ4_resetStream_fast() 之后对同一工作流调用 LZ4_attach_dictionary() 再继续压缩，正好经过这一状态转换；定额 fuzz 下新增状态代码在多个种子中被执行，往返校验无异常。harness 无需修改，属于隐式 state 阴性。
rationale_en: When a dictionary is attached to a freshly cleared working stream, this commit records a new state marker (the table is no longer treated as cleared) for LZ4_prepareTable() to check later: new internal state in the stream object's reuse contract, which on the surface matches a silent state positive. But round_trip_stream_fuzzer calls LZ4_attach_dictionary() on the same working stream after LZ4_resetStream_fast() and keeps compressing, passing exactly through this state transition; under the fuzz budget the new state code runs in several seeds and the round-trip checks hold. No harness update needed: silent state negative.
